reviewer: Codex: direct source-document and real-trace inspection
scope: This pinned Phase-1 methodological sample only; not a reusable automatic semantic approval

reviewed.schema: Official ITCH 2.0 pages 2-5; all observed message types and lengths match. No invented replace event.
reviewed.timestamp: Official integer milliseconds since Eastern midnight; date corroborated by filename and ZIP date. File order retained; no exchange sequence claimed.
reviewed.scaling: Official implied four-decimal USD field and integer shares; source trace additions and decrements agree with those units.
reviewed.venue: Protocol history supports legacy Island/INET lineage; Nasdaq is the hosting source, not proof of contemporary venue identity in 2003.
reviewed.day_end: Preserve outstanding IDs through explicit trailing X messages; specification page-2 and revision-history wording conflict. EOF exhaustion supplies a real consistency check.
reviewed.real_traces: Twelve compact transitions reviewed: three each A/X/E/P. All show expected order quantity and top-book effects; P leaves visible depth unchanged.
reviewed.licensing: No redistribution grant established. Raw, row-level derivatives and traces stay local and are ignored by Git. No publication occurred.

unresolved: Single legacy day cannot establish modern-market generalization.
No original transport sequence, independent exchange snapshot or receive timestamps.
No explicit auction/halt state; output uses documented time-of-day proxy.
Instrument/venue legal minimum tick not independently established; encoding quantum and empirical grid distinguished.
decision_basis: These limitations restrict later research claims but do not prevent interpreting and validating this sample's observable order book. The numerical, lineage, trace and test gates must still pass separately.
